title: MRI Films and Reports — What the Words Mean and What They Do Not

hook.en: "Disc bulge", "degenerative changes", "tear". MRI reports can frighten patients, and many findings are common in people with no pain. Learn how MRI works, how to read an image's brightness and how to put a report in perspective.
hook.ur: "Disc bulge", "degenerative changes", "tear". MRI reports mareezon ko daraa sakti hain, aur bohat si findings bina dard wale logon mein aam hain. Seekhein MRI kaise kaam karta hai, tasveer ki roshni kaise parhein aur report ko sahi nazariye se kaise dekhein.

goal.en: By the end, you'll tell T1 and T2 images apart, name the planes, understand common spine and joint report terms, and explain to a patient what a finding means for treatment.
goal.ur: End tak aap T1 aur T2 tasveerein alag karenge, planes ke naam batayenge, spine aur joint report ke aam alfaz samjhenge, aur mareez ko batayenge ke finding ka ilaj ke liye kya matlab hai.

text.en: An **MRI** uses a strong magnet and radio waves, not radiation, to build detailed pictures of **soft tissue**: discs, nerves, the spinal cord, ligaments, tendons, cartilage and bone marrow. Pictures come in different **sequences**. On a **T1** image, **fat is bright and fluid is dark**. On a **T2** image, **fluid is bright** (the water in a disc, a cyst or swelling shows white). Pictures are shown in slices in three planes: **sagittal** (side), **axial** (cross-section) and **coronal** (front).
text.ur: **MRI** mazboot magnet aur radio waves istemal karta hai, radiation nahi, aur **narm tissue** ki tafseeli tasveerein banata hai: disc, nerves, spinal cord, ligaments, tendons, cartilage aur bone marrow. Tasveerein mukhtalif **sequences** mein aati hain. **T1** par **charbi roshan aur paani kaala** hota hai. **T2** par **paani roshan** hota hai (disc ka paani, cyst ya sujan safed nazar aati hai). Tasveerein teen planes mein slices mein dikhai jati hain: **sagittal** (side), **axial** (cross-section) aur **coronal** (samne).

text.en: Think of MRI as **a very detailed map of water and fat** in the body. Tissue that is rich in water, such as a swollen tendon or a healthy disc, lights up on T2; fat lights up on T1. The report is a translator of the map. But a map of a street also shows old cracks and patches that do not cause any traffic trouble, which is exactly what many "degenerative changes" are.
text.ur: MRI ko **jism mein paani aur charbi ka bohat tafseeli naqsha** samjhein. Jo tissue paani se bharpoor ho, maslan soojha tendon ya sehatmand disc, T2 par roshan hota hai; charbi T1 par. Report is naqshe ki tarjuman hai. Magar sarak ka naqsha purani dararein aur patch bhi dikhata hai jo traffic ka koi masla nahi karte, aur bohat si "degenerative changes" bilkul yehi hain.

title.en: Putting an MRI report in context
title.ur: MRI report ko sahi nazariye se dekhna

steps.title: Know why it was done
steps.detail: Check the clinical question and the region, because the radiologist describes what matches that question. Note any contrast and the date of the scan. || Wajah jaanein

steps.title: Read the main sections
steps.detail: Findings list each structure; the impression gives the conclusion. Note severity words (mild, moderate, severe) and whether a change is "acute" or "chronic". || Mukhya hissay parhein

steps.title: Separate the common from the concerning
steps.detail: Disc degeneration, mild bulges and small tears are common without pain. Concerning findings are those that match the patient: a large extrusion pressing a nerve root that fits the leg symptoms, cord compression, a fracture, infection or a tumour. || Aam aur fikr wali findings alag karein

steps.title: Match it to the patient and explain
steps.detail: Ask whether the finding explains the symptoms and examination. Tell the patient in plain words what it means and that most people recover with exercise and activity; refer when there are red flags or a surgical question. || Mareez se milayein aur samjhayein

text.en: **Most "changes" are normal wear.** Disc degeneration is found in about a third of 20-year-olds with no back pain and in nearly everyone by age 80, so a finding means something only when it matches the patient's symptoms and examination.
text.ur: **Zyada tar "tabdeeliyan" normal ghisaai hain.** Disc degeneration bina kamar dard ke takreeban ek tihai 20 saal walon mein aur 80 saal tak lagbhag sab mein milti hai, is liye finding tab hi maani rakhti hai jab woh mareez ki alamaat aur examination se mile.

text.en: **Telling a patient their "bulging disc" or "arthritis" explains everything.** Frightening words can make patients fear movement and avoid activity, which delays recovery. Explain that a bulge is common and often painless, and that the plan is to move and strengthen. Treat the person, not the scan.
text.ur: **Mareez ko kehna ke un ki "ubhri hui disc" ya "arthritis" sab kuch samjhati hai.** Daraune alfaz mareez ko harkat se darwa kar activity se door kar sakte hain, jo shifa mein takheer karta hai. Samjhayein ke ubhaar aam aur aksar dard ke baghair hota hai, aur plan harkat aur taaqat ka hai. Mareez ka ilaj karein, scan ka nahi.

question.en: An MRI report says "mild disc bulge at L4/5" in a 35-year-old with 2 days of back pain and no red flags. What is the best response?
question.ur: 35 saal ke mareez ko 2 din ka kamar dard hai, red flags nahi, MRI report mein "L4/5 par halka disc bulge" likha hai. Behtareen jawab kya hai?

text.en: Explain that this is common and likely unrelated, and advise staying active with graded exercise
text.ur: Samjhayein ke yeh aam hai aur shayad be-talluq, aur active rehne aur darje war exercise ka mashwara dein

feedback.en: Yes — most acute back pain improves, and the finding is common without pain.
feedback.ur: Haan — zyada tar tazah kamar dard behtar ho jata hai, aur finding bina dard bhi aam hai.

text.en: Tell the patient to rest in bed until it heals
text.ur: Theek hone tak bistar par aaram ka kahein

feedback.ur: Aaram shifa mein takheer karta hai.

text.ur: Batayein ke surgery ka imkaan hai

question.en: Which MRI finding with these symptoms is an emergency?
question.ur: In alamaat ke saath MRI ki kaun si finding emergency hai?

feedback.en: That is often a normal finding.

text.en: A large disc compressing the cauda equina with saddle numbness and bladder change
text.ur: Bara disc jo cauda equina dabaye, saddle sunn hona aur peshab mein tabdeeli ke saath

feedback.en: Yes — this needs same-day surgical review.
feedback.ur: Haan — is ko usi din surgical review chahiye.

feedback.en: That is common and rarely urgent.
feedback.ur: Yeh aam hai aur kam hi urgent.

text.en: **Use the report as a starting point for explanation.** Say: "The scan shows normal wear for your age, like grey hair, plus one disc that is a bit irritated. This is not dangerous, and most people get better with movement and strengthening." Review progress, and request referral only if the picture or red flags change.
text.ur: **Report ko wazahat ka aaghaz banayein.** Kahein: "Scan aap ki umar ke mutabiq normal ghisaai, safed baalon ki tarah, aur ek disc thori chirchiri dikhata hai. Yeh khatarnak nahi, aur zyada tar log harkat aur taaqat se behtar ho jate hain." Progress dekhein, aur referral tab maangein jab tasveer ya red flags badlein.

question.en: Why can an MRI show a disc bulge in someone with no back pain?
question.ur: Bina kamar dard ke shakhs mein bhi MRI disc bulge kyun dikha sakta hai?

answer.en: Discs change with age and use, much as skin and hair do, and many of these changes do not irritate a nerve or cause pain. MRI is very sensitive, so it shows them, but pain depends on many things beyond structure, such as movement, load, sleep, mood and beliefs.
answer.ur: Discs umar aur istemal ke saath badalti hain, jaise jild aur baal, aur in mein se bohat si tabdeeliyan nerve ko chirchira nahi karti na dard paida karti hain. MRI bohat sensitive hai, is liye unhein dikha deta hai, magar dard saakht se ziyada cheezon par munhasir hai, maslan harkat, load, neend, mood aur khayalat.

beats.patient: A 52-year-old man has had 3 months of right buttock and calf pain with numbness in the outer foot. The MRI report says "right L5/S1 posterolateral disc protrusion contacting the right S1 nerve root", and examination shows a reduced ankle jerk.
beats.assessment: The finding matches the symptoms and examination, so it is likely clinically relevant, but there are no emergency signs.
beats.treatment: Explain, continue active rehabilitation and nerve-friendly exercise, review in a few weeks, and refer for an opinion if there is progressive weakness or severe pain.
beats.reassess: After 8 weeks the leg symptoms ease and he returns to work; no surgery needed.

text.en: **Refer urgently** for a scan report with cord or cauda equina compression, a fracture or instability, suspected infection or tumour, or when symptoms include saddle numbness, bladder or bowel change, progressive weakness, unexplained weight loss, fever or constant night pain. Check for contraindications before MRI (pacemaker, some implants, metal in the eye or pregnancy) and follow the imaging team's rules.
text.ur: **Foran refer karein** jab report mein cord ya cauda equina ka dabao, fracture ya instability, mumkin infection ya tumour ho, ya alamaat mein saddle sunn hona, peshab ya pakhane mein tabdeeli, barhti kamzori, be-wajah wazan ka girna, bukhar ya musalsal raat ka dard ho. MRI se pehle contraindications (pacemaker, kuch implants, aankh mein dhaat ya hamal) check karein aur imaging team ke qawaid maanein.

summary.en: MRI uses a magnet, not radiation, to show soft tissue; on T1 fat is bright and fluid is dark, on T2 fluid is bright.
summary.ur: MRI magnet istemal karta hai, radiation nahi, narm tissue dikhane ke liye; T1 par charbi roshan aur paani kaala, T2 par paani roshan.

summary.en: Many MRI findings (disc degeneration, mild bulges) are common without pain; they matter when they match the symptoms and examination.
summary.ur: MRI ki bohat si findings (disc degeneration, halke bulges) bina dard ke aam hain; woh tab ahem hain jab alamaat aur examination se milen.

summary.en: Explain reports in plain words, avoid frightening language and refer urgently for cord compression or red flags.
summary.ur: Reports saade alfaz mein samjhayein, daraune alfaz se bachein aur cord compression ya red flags par foran refer karein.
